decline_offer.subject: Thank You for the Offer
decline_offer.body:
Hi Priscilla,

Thank you very much for the offer, and for the time you and the desk spent with me across three rounds.

After thinking it through carefully, I am going to decline. The full-time role that follows this summer cannot be sponsored, and I have accepted a position elsewhere where the path after graduation is clear. This is a visa question rather than a judgment of the firm or the team, and I want to be clear about that.

You were generous with your time from the first conversation onward, and the desk was the most interesting place I visited this autumn. I would genuinely like to stay in touch, and if the policy ever changes, I would welcome the chance to talk again.

Thank you again for everything!

Best,

This is a slightly awkward ask, so I will be direct. When we spoke, you mentioned that you were close with someone on the industrials team at Halyard Point.
